diagnostics.message: delete_http_settings depends on create-time set_probe, whose destruction is a no-op, so it does not enforce teardown ordering against delete_probe. HTTP settings reference the probe, so delete_http_settings must be destroyed before delete_probe; add delete_probe (or replace set_probe) in depends_on.
set_probe is created after set_backend_pools, but delete_probe has no destroy-time ordering. To reverse the create ordering safely, delete_probe must be destroyed before delete_backend_pool.

delete_http_listener depends on create-time set_frontend_port, which has no destroy provisioner, rather than on delete_frontend_port. The listener references the frontend port, so during teardown delete_http_listener must run before delete_frontend_port.
